items.head: Cheap stuff I'll replace
items.sub: One $120 pair of boots beats three $40 pairs.

items.head: Premium for things I don't care about

label: NUMBER 7

text: Spend big on what you use every day. Cut *everything else.*

head: Cheap is a habit. Rich is a *filter.*
